section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1980
title: 29 Distribution of Suicides according to age : The statistics of suicides by age revealed that the maximum suicides (18,173) were committed by persons belonging to the age group 18-30 years (43.6%) of the total suicide cases reported in the country and the minimum (5,023) were committed by persons above 50 years of age sharing 12.1 percent of the total suicides in the country. Total number of suicides committed by the persons between 30 to 50 years was (11,822) and it registered 28.4 percent of the total suicides while the persons below 18 years of age accounted for 15.9 percent of the total suicides reported during 1980 registering a total number of suicides as 6,645. The age-wise distribution of suicides for all the States together and the country as a whole was almost the same during 1980 with a little difference in the Union Territories and Metropolitan Cities as a whole.
